The existing oracle remains required after final APT boundaries; preserve libpq/curl/LDAP/SASL ABI. Unexpected plugins or custom SASL_PATH require review. Wheel-vendored implementations and non-inspected runtime containers are outside this fresh runtime observation. New CVEs, package/version changes, Critical findings and expiry remain fail-closed. This is a bounded residual-risk decision, not vendor remediation or a universal non-reachability claim. Preserve package identities, existing native-build checks and all candidate/development/preprod/termination/rolling/cleanup gates. Review before 2026-10-15 09:00 KST; retire an acceptance only after exact-image remediation evidence. Current evidence, limitations and review ownership: docs/operations/container-image-security.md.
